svg.title: Displacement paths A, B, C and D
svg.desc: A number line from 0 to 12 m. Path A goes from 0 to 7 m. Path B goes from 12 m to 7 m. Path C goes from 2 m to 10 m, back to 8 m, then to 10 m. Path D goes from 9 m to 3 m, then to 5 m. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Follow the route; compare distance with displacement
Gold accumulates path length. Blue shows signed displacement from the start.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
